metrics.name: Standard Agent Invariant & Outcome Pass Rate

metrics.name: Adversarial & Planted Defect Detection Rate (Observer Sensitivity)
metrics.numeratorDescription: Number of rogue-agent / spoofed-transport scenarios accurately flagged as FAIL by IndependentObserver

metrics.name: Standard Agent Claim-to-State Support Rate

metrics.denominatorDescription: Total positive outcome claims emitted by STANDARD_SAFE agent
metrics.inclusionRule: Structured outcome claims in STANDARD_SAFE runs
metrics.exclusionRule: Intentional false claims in ROGUE_* agent runs
